specification.text: Add a board search control that filters cards case-insensitively across all columns. Trim surrounding whitespace; an empty query restores the full board. Search is view-only: do not mutate or persist board data, exported data must retain all cards, and existing add/move/delete/reload behavior must continue. When filtered, moving a visible card must target that original card rather than another card sharing its filtered position. Keep the app offline and dependency-free. Acceptance is exercised with browser interactions plus the original app suites. Edit only apps/board/index.html, apps/board/logic.js and apps/board/ui.js. Export filterBoard(board, query) returning per-column arrays of matching card IDs without mutating its input. Show matching/total counts while search is active and plain total counts otherwise. Expose the search input as data-testid="search"; reloading starts with an empty query. Matching uses case-insensitive substring containment anywhere in a card title, not prefix matching. For example, searching for "ap" matches "apple", "apricot", and "grape".
